title: The warning never changes the price the rule gives
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, with one range from $0.00: Default on Margin % 40, tier A on % Off 95.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's 95% off shows the warning icon.
  • The Price Part Simulator at $100.00 shows Default $166.67 ($100.00 ÷ 0.60 = $166.666…, rounded to $166.67).
  • It shows tier A $8.33 and a profit of −$91.67 (5% of $166.67 = $8.3335, rounded to $8.33, $8.33 − $100.00 = −$91.67): the warning did not raise the price.
